name: Document Uploaded — Ingestion & Index Verification Hook
description: Verifies that the document ingestion pipeline (text extraction, metadata generation, 512-token chunking with 50-token overlap, offline deterministic lexical embedding, and IndexedDB search index update) maintains R-PBT-5 and R-PBT-6 invariants when ingestion modules change.

actions.prompt: Verify that the document upload pipeline preserves: (1) non-blocking Web Worker text extraction via PDF.js and Markdown/TXT splitters, (2) Archivist metadata extraction, (3) 512-token chunking with 50-token overlap, (4) deterministic, offline 384-d Float32Array lexical embeddings from computeDeterministicEmbedding (no model download, no network requests; not a neural model), and (5) IndexedDB Chunk_Store index updates. Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/chunker.test.ts` to confirm R-PBT-5 and R-PBT-6 pass.
